R1_replay_reproducible.detail: rerun identical and refactor differs beyond tol in 0 segments
R1_replay_reproducible.rule: the replay tool itself is reproducible: re-run identical, refactor within tolerance

R2_closed_loop_logs.rule: non-inferior to the IDM baseline on held-out logs: upper 95 % bound of the collision rate <= baseline rate + 1 point (worst seed)

R3_braking_slice.rule: same on the slice where the lead brakes (fewer trajectories, so margin 5 points)

R4_scenario_grid.detail: 70.2 % of the grid avoidable-but-collides vs baseline 0.0 % + 2 points
R4_scenario_grid.rule: collision area on the cut-in grid that is physically avoidable <= baseline + 2 points (t_react = 0.6 s)

R5_seed_stability.rule: collision rate varies by <= 1 point across training seeds

R6_reactive_world.rule: collision area with a REACTIVE rear vehicle <= baseline + 2 points

R7_coverage.rule: enough scenarios were actually run: >= 100 mined braking events, >= 2000 grid cells
